name: Model independence and provenance
summary: Make atlas-owned BPMN authoring the future default while preserving versioned Zeebe import/reload compatibility, replacing Camunda-specific DMN authoring only with test evidence, and completing third-party provenance and licence gates.
next_action: Review PR #1459's DMN fork and npm-lockfile licence evidence; inspect actual generated DMN JS/CSS/font bundle, run reproducible rebuild and SBOM/notice checks, verify copied fixtures, and explicitly accept or revise ADR-0513 before authoring changes.

slices.title: Provenance evidence and architecture gate
slices.note: Merged #1443 (initial evidence/Proposed ADR) and #1447 (Zeebe and DMN moddle MIT provenance). PR #1459 checks pinned dmn-js/dmn-moddle fork licences and vendor lockfile metadata. MIP0 remains active: actual bundled dependencies, reproducibility, fork/source/fixture audit, SBOM, watermark and ADR-0513 acceptance are not complete.

slices.title: Native BPMN authoring with legacy round-trip
slices.note: Build a reviewed atlas namespace descriptor and test new default authoring alongside lossless Zeebe import/export; no silent conversion.

slices.title: Compiler compatibility and restart recovery
slices.note: Enforce namespace-aware compatibility at deploy; test unsupported/conflicting extensions, historical definition reload and live/replay equality.

slices.title: DMN editor independence
slices.note: Replace Camunda-specific authoring modules without losing existing DMN/version-tag data or changing temis execution.

slices.title: Release provenance and compatibility sign-off
slices.note: Complete upstream/fixture audit, copyright notices, vendor bundle rebuild evidence, SBOM, watermark and compatibility matrix; maintain separate legal trademark gate.
